_readme: Provider prices (USD per 1M tokens, what Fuel pays) for closed-model labs. VERIFY each against the provider's official pricing page before syncing: these were gathered from third-party price lists in Nov 2026, which disagree in places. Fuel adds its markup on top. scripts/sync-closed-models.mjs only enables entries whose provider_model_id exists in the provider's live model list AND answer a test call. Long-context surcharges (e.g. Haiku above 100K input tokens) are not billed separately, so context is capped at the cheaper tier. Re-run the sync after any price change.
